_doc: PILOT-OFFER-1 (Q-GROW-PILOT-OFFER): the pilot offer as data. Rendered on /pilot by site/worker.js (pilotOffer in site/pilotoffer.js); site/site.test.mjs fails when the page and this file disagree. The price is a hypothesis with a rule for revising it from measured cost; no figure is published until a measured cost exists to support it, so price.monthly_usd and price.range_usd stay null and the page says so. Changing a value is a reviewed pull request with a revert.

who_for.heading: Who the pilot is for
who_for.intro: A system you already run, or want to run, that passes all four questions:

questions.ask: Is there a loop it must close?
questions.means: Something is observed, acted on and observed again, with no person in the middle.

questions.ask: Is there a measure that can be wrong?
questions.means: A named metric or probe that can breach, with a prediction logged before each change and scored after.
Failures, drift, new sources or new rules keep creating work, so a next improvement is available.

questions.ask: Is there a running cost you accept?
questions.means: Compute, model calls and storage cost money each month, and you state the monthly budget.

includes.heading: What the pilot includes
items: A tenant of the same shape Ultrastable runs on itself, in your own account.
Your objectives and metrics, written with you and probed from the first day.
The loops that close them, each with a stated interval and an owner.
A monthly budget you set, which the system keeps inside.
A dashboard of your own system and the audit trail of its changes.

price.heading: What it costs
price.rule: Your monthly fee is the measured running cost of your system plus a management fee set after the first improvement cycle. The cost is shown to you as a measured number, not an estimate.
price.revision: After each month the fee is compared with the measured cost of that month (model calls, compute and storage from the cost log). A fee that sat above or below the rule by more than the stated tolerance is revised in the next month's offer.
price.revised_from: throughput.model_cost in the live record, and each pilot's own cost log
price.default_in_effect: No list price. Each pilot is quoted after its first measured cycle.
